I switched to the 32-bit version of R (but still using the 64-bit version of Win7).  The following code executes, and I can zoom fine and preview the pdf fine (and see the attachment).  What does this snippet do on your machine?  Could you post a small example of a dataframe that produces the problem?  If your example works on my machine, I'll update my old 32 bit Win7 laptop and try it there.  -Will
 
require(ggplot2)
#x <- 1:10 #This variation works too
#x <- factor(1:10) #This variation works too
x <- factor(rep(1:3, times=10))
y <- rnorm(length(x))
data <- data.frame(x, y)
ggplot(data, aes(x,y)) + geom_boxplot() + theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=-35, hjust=0))
sessionInfo()
